dataset_story: CICIDS2017 is a comprehensive network traffic dataset capturing common attacks and benign traffic. In AURA, it is primarily used to identify DDoS attempts and infrastructure masking.
aura_purpose: Detects large-scale network-level threats and identifies malicious infrastructure environments.

citation.text: Sharafaldin, I., et al. (2018). Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset and Intrusion Traffic Characterization. ICISSP.
